title: Low Motion Profile Switcher
user: A motion-sensitive computer user who needs a reliable way to reduce distracting or nauseating animation in selected apps and browser tabs without losing useful state changes.
smallest_useful_product: A browser extension that applies per-site low-motion profiles: pause nonessential autoplay/animated backgrounds, suppress rapid transforms, retain explicit progress/status changes, and offer a one-click temporary exception.
success_measure: In a two-week pilot, users keep the profile enabled on at least five sites and rate fewer than 10% of resulting page changes as lost important information.
constraints: Respect site security boundaries; avoid modifying sensitive input data; make every rule reversible; clearly distinguish motion comfort from medical treatment.
